subcategory_text: Data are processed to limit observability and linkability (e.g., data actions take place on local devices, privacy-preserving cryptography).
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SC-8, SC-28 (Protection of Information at Rest)
GDPR Art. 25 (Data protection by design and by default), Art. 32
implementation_examples: Process data so that observability and linkability are limited (e.g., process on local devices, use privacy-preserving cryptography such as secure multi-party computation, homomorphic encryption)
Document the privacy-preserving pattern in the architecture decision log
Validate linkability reductions through tests before deployment
assessment_objectives: Determine whether data processing limits observability and linkability
Determine whether the privacy-preserving pattern is documented as an architectural decision
Determine whether linkability reductions are validated by tests
Determine whether the pattern supports the intended processing outcome
